title.en: Burnham announces bus fares across England to be capped at £2

title.en: More warehouses of Russian online retailer Wildberries hit by Ukraine, officials say
title.zh: 官员称，俄罗斯在线零售商Wildberries更多仓库遭乌克兰袭击

summary.en: Logistics hubs belonging to the Russian online retailer Wildberries in Krasnodar and Stavropol were reportedly struck overnight by Ukraine.
summary.zh: 据报道，俄罗斯在线零售商Wildberries位于克拉斯诺达尔和斯塔夫罗波尔的物流中心于周二夜间遭到乌克兰袭击。

body.en:
Ukrainian drones have hit warehouses belonging to Russia's biggest online retailer again, injuring 10 people, according to Russian media and the region's governor.

Logistics hubs belonging to Wildberries in Krasnodar and Stavropol were struck during overnight strikes, forcing workers to be evacuated, the company's owner said.

It is the second time Ukraine has attacked the firm's facilities in four days, with warehouses in Tambov and Elektrostal hit on Saturday, killing eight and injuring 62.

Kyiv has claimed the warehouses have been used to supply components to make Russia's drones and navigation equipment.

Wildberries owner Tatyana Kim said on Telegram that "there are no words to describe all the feelings and emotions caused by the attacks on ordinary people, on our employees, on us, who are simply doing our jobs."

"But these situations demonstrate the most important thing: we must continue to do what we do for the benefit of people."

Serhii Kuzan, chairman of the Ukrainian Security and Cooperation Centre, has previously told BBC that Wildberries' website had been used by Russian volunteers to buy military equipment.

"The primary rationale for striking Wildberries' warehouses is to disrupt Russian logistics and the supply of dual-use goods, critical electronics, sanctioned goods and the like to the Russian army and Russian arms manufacturers," he said.

"The collateral damage from such strikes could also have a serious impact on the Russian economy, as well as a psychological effect on Russian society and, likely, on continued support for the war."
body.zh: 据俄罗斯媒体和该地区州长称，乌克兰无人机再次袭击了俄罗斯最大在线零售商的仓库，造成 10 人受伤。 该公司所有者表示，该公司位于克拉斯诺达尔和斯塔夫罗波尔的物流中心在夜间罢工中遭到袭击，迫使工人撤离。 这是乌克兰四天内第二次袭击该公司的设施，周六坦波夫和埃莱克特罗斯塔尔的仓库遭到袭击，造成 8 人死亡、62 人受伤。 基辅声称这些仓库已被用来供应制造俄罗斯无人机和导航设备的零部件。 Wildberry 老板塔蒂亚娜·金 (Tatyana Kim) 在 Telegram 上表示，“普通人、我们的员工、我们这些只是在做我们工作的人受到攻击，所造成的所有感受和情绪是无法用语言来形容的。” “但这些情况表明了最重要的事情：我们必须继续为人民的利益做我们所做的事情。” 乌克兰安全与合作中心主席谢尔希·库赞(Serhii Kuzan)此前曾告诉BBC，俄罗斯志愿者曾利用Wildberry 的网站购买军事装备。 他说：“袭击 Wildberry 仓库的主要理由是扰乱俄罗斯的物流以及向俄罗斯军队和俄罗斯武器制造商供应军民两用商品、关键电子产品、受制裁商品等。” “此类袭击造成的附带损害还可能对俄罗斯经济产生严重影响，并对俄罗斯社会产生心理影响，并可能对战争的持续支持产生影响。”

reflection.en: News of continued strikes on infrastructure reminds us of the destructive nature of ongoing conflict and the temptation to respond to harm with further harm. Yahweh calls us not to be overcome by evil, but to actively seek ways to overcome evil with good, even amidst escalating tensions. This path, though challenging, is the only one that truly breaks...
reflection.zh: 持续袭击基础设施的消息提醒我们，冲突的破坏性本质以及以伤害回应伤害的诱惑。雅伟呼召我们不要被邪恶所胜，而要积极寻求以善胜恶的方式，即使在紧张局势升级之时。这条道路虽然充满挑战，却是真正打破暴力循环、迈向持久和平的唯一途径。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Japan temperatures soar over 40C, marking first 'cruelly hot day'
title.zh: 日本气温飙升至40摄氏度以上，迎来首个“酷热日”

summary.en: Japan has experienced its first "cruelly hot day" with temperatures exceeding 40C, a term recently introduced by the weather agency to describe such extreme heat.
summary.zh: 日本经历了第一个“酷热日”，气温超过40摄氏度，这是气象机构最近引入的用于描述此类极端高温的术语。

body.en:
Japan has experienced its first "kokushobi", or "cruelly hot day", as temperatures in parts of the country climbed past 40C (104F).

The term was introduced in April by the country's weather agency to describe days when temperatures reach 40C, with the aim of more effectively warning the public about dangerous heat.

On Tuesday, temperatures in three central Japanese cities - Tajimi, Gujo, and Toyoda - hit that threshold. The heat is expected to continue into next week, said Japan's Meteorological Agency (JMA).

It comes as extreme weather events like heatwaves are becoming more intense around the world. Last year, Japan saw its highest-ever temperature of 41.8C in the city of Isesaki.

Days with temperatures exceeding 35C are known as moshobi - or "extremely hot days".

But its more severe counterpart uses the term koku - meaning harsh or cruel - to describe the heat.

Nearly 300 out of the country's 914 observation points recorded a moshobi on Tuesday, Kyodo News reported.

It also comes as authorities have issued heatstroke alerts in more than 40 prefectures across the country. They have also advised people to use air-conditioners, drink enough water and consume salt, as well as avoid prolonged outdoor activities.

The Tokyo Fire Department said a total of 287 people, aged three to 103, were taken to the city's hospitals on Tuesday because of apparent heatstroke - the highest number recorded this year, said national broadcaster NHK.

The fire department also issued an ambulance overload alert on Wednesday and urged people to protect themselves from the heat.

It comes as Japan's summers are getting hotter and more dangerous. Last year, the number of people who suffered heatstrokes at their workplaces reached a record 1,803, said a report by news outlet Kyodo. Nineteen of them died.

As Japan braces for another hot summer, the Tokyo government has encouraged office workers to adopt more casual attire like T-shirts and shorts , instead of suit and ties, because of the heat.
body.zh: 日本经历了第一个“kokushobi”，即“酷热的一天”，该国部分地区的气温攀升至 40 摄氏度（104 华氏度）以上。 该术语由该国气象局于四月推出，用于描述气温达到 40 摄氏度的日子，目的是更有效地警告公众有关危险的高温。 周二，日本中部三个城市多治见市、郡上市市和丰田市的气温达到了这一阈值。日本气象厅（JMA）表示，预计高温天气将持续到下周。 随着热浪等极端天气事件在世界各地变得越来越严重。去年，日本伊势崎市的最高气温达到 41.8 摄氏度。 气温超过 35°C 的日子被称为 moshobi，即“酷热天”。 但其更严厉的对应词使用“koku”一词（意思是严酷或残忍）来描述炎热。 据共同社报道，周二，该国 914 个观测点中有近 300 个观测点记录到了莫肖比。 与此同时，当局已向全国 40 多个县发布中暑警报。他们还建议人们使用空调，多喝水和盐，并避免长时间户外活动。 东京消防局表示，周二共有 287 名年龄在 3 岁至 103 岁之间的人因明显中暑被送往该市医院，这是今年有记录以来的最高数字。 消防部门周三还发布了救护车超载警报，并敦促人们保护自己免受高温侵害。 日本的夏季变得越来越热，也越来越危险。据共同社报道，去年在工作场所中暑的人数达到创纪录的 1,803 人。其中十九人死亡。 随着日本迎来又一个炎热的夏季，东京政府鼓励上班族穿 T 恤和短裤等更休闲的服装，而不是西装和领带，因为天气炎热。

reflection.en: The report of Japan's "cruelly hot day" reminds us that creation itself can feel the strain of changing conditions. Romans 8:22 speaks of the whole creation groaning, a poignant image that resonates when extreme weather impacts our world. It invites us to consider our role in the well-being of the earth and its inhabitants.
reflection.zh: 日本出现“酷热日”的报道提醒我们，受不断变化的环境影响，受造界本身也会感受到压力。罗马书8:22提到整个受造界一同叹息，当极端天气影响我们的世界时，这个生动的画面引起了共鸣。它邀请我们思考自己在地球及其居民福祉中的角色。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Mamdani urges US government to arrest Netanyahu if Israeli PM visits US
title.zh: 马姆达尼敦促美国政府在内塔尼亚胡访问美国时将其逮捕

summary.en: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani stated he lacks the authority to arrest Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu but urged the US federal government to do so if Netanyahu visits the US. Mamdani described the Israeli Prime Minister as the "architect of a horrific genocide."
summary.zh: 纽约市市长佐赫兰·马姆达尼表示，他无权逮捕以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡，但他敦促美国联邦政府在内塔尼亚胡访问美国时将其逮捕。马姆达尼称以色列总理是“一场可怕种族灭绝的策划者”。

title.en: Zelensky sacks Ukraine's top army commander after days of protests
title.zh: 泽连斯基在数日抗议后解雇乌克兰最高陆军指挥官

summary.en: Ukraine's President Zelensky has dismissed the country's top army commander, Oleksandr Syrskyi. This decision follows days of public protests and backlash concerning the earlier removal of popular Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov.
summary.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基解除了该国最高陆军指挥官奥列克桑德尔·瑟尔斯基的职务。此前，由于广受欢迎的国防部长米哈伊洛·费多罗夫被免职，引发了数日的公众抗议和强烈反对。

body.en:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has dismissed the country's army commander-in-chief, Oleksandr Syrskyi.

It comes just days after the removal of popular Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov - a move that triggered street protests across the country.

Initial rumours that the end of Fedorov's tenure was related to a conflict between him and Syrskyi were soon confirmed.

Fedorov, 35, has been widely praised for energising the ministry and transforming the armed forces, as well as leading a drive against corruption. Syrskyi, 60, is seen by many in Ukraine as a Soviet-school commander reluctant to implement radical changes in the army.

Syrskyi defended his record in a farewell address, writing on Telegram: "An army that was fighting a difficult defensive campaign two years ago is now on the offensive."

"I am handing over to my successor an army that is not only holding the line but is advancing... I sincerely hope this offensive will continue."

Syrskyi was replaced by Mykhailo Drapatyi, 43, who is a popular, battle-hardened general.

"I will work responsibly, with full focus, and with respect for the people who are defending our country today," Drapatyi said on Facebook.

He also thanked Syrskyi "for his consistent work to strengthen the Ukrainian army," adding: "I grew up in it."

In a video post on social media late on Tuesday, Zelensky thanked Syrskyi for his military campaigns, including his role in successfully defending the capital Kyiv during the first days of Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022.

Zelensky also revealed that earlier in the day, he met Fedorov and offered him a "worthy position in power", but did not say whether the offer had been accepted.

Fedorov was last week replaced by Yevhenii Khmara, a former top official at Ukraine's Security Service (SBU).

Meanwhile, Fedorov congratulated Drapatyi with his new job, describing his appointment as a "new hope in the fight of free people for freedom and justice".

Fedorov also revealed that he had called Syrskyi to thank him for the defence of the Kyiv region and other "historic battles".

"But we need to move even faster and write new chapters correcting all previous mistakes," he added.

Fedorov had been appointed defence minister only in January - but has been widely praised for using data to analyse and try to improve performance on the front line.

A former minister of digital transformation, he was active from the early days of the full-scale invasion by setting up a volunteer "IT Army of Ukraine" to launch cyber-attacks against Russia.

Later, he led a successful fundraising campaign called the Army of Drones and brought in elements of "gamification" to the war, designing a system that awarded Ukrainian military units with credits for hitting Russian assets.

body.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基解雇了该国陆军总司令亚历山大·西尔斯基。 就在几天前，受欢迎的国防部长米哈伊洛·费多罗夫被免职，这一举动引发了全国各地的街头抗议。 最初有关费多罗夫任期结束与他和西尔斯基之间的冲突有关的传言很快得到证实。 35 岁的费多罗夫因激励国防部、改造武装部队以及领导反腐败运动而受到广泛赞誉。 60 岁的西尔斯基被许多乌克兰人视为苏联派指挥官，不愿对军队进行彻底变革。 西尔斯基在告别演说中为自己的战绩进行了辩护，他在 Telegram 上写道：“两年前正在进行艰难防御的军队现在正在进攻。” “我将向我的继任者移交一支不仅坚守阵线而且正在前进的军队……我真诚地希望这场攻势能够继续下去。” 西尔斯基被 43 岁的米哈伊洛·德拉帕蒂 (Mykhailo Drapatiy) 接替，他是一位受人欢迎、身经百战的将军。 德拉帕蒂在脸书上表示：“我将负责任地、全神贯注地工作，并尊重今天保卫我们国家的人们。” 他还感谢西尔斯基“为加强乌克兰军队所做的持续努力”，并补充道：“我是在其中长大的。” 周二晚间，泽伦斯基在社交媒体上发布视频，感谢西尔斯基的军事行动，包括他在 2022 年俄罗斯全面入侵的最初几天里成功保卫首都基辅所发挥的作用。 泽连斯基还透露，当天早些时候，他会见了费多罗夫，并向他提供了“有价值的权力职位”，但没有透露这一提议是否已被接受。 费多罗夫上周被乌克兰安全局（SBU）前高级官员叶夫尼·赫马拉（Yevhenii Khmara）接替。 与此同时，费多罗夫祝贺德拉帕蒂的新工作，称他的任命是“自由人民争取自由和正义的新希望”。 费多罗夫还透露，他曾致电西尔斯基，感谢他保卫基辅地区和其他“历史性战役”。 “但我们需要更快地行动，撰写新的篇章，纠正以前的所有错误，”他补充道。 费多罗夫在一月份才被任命为国防部长，但因利用数据分析并试图提高前线表现而受到广泛赞誉。 作为前数字化转型部长，他从全面入侵初期就很活跃，组建了一支志愿“乌克兰IT军”，对俄罗斯发动网络攻击。 后来，他成功领导了一场名为“无人机军团”的筹款活动，并将“游戏化”元素引入战争，设计了一个系统，为乌克兰军事单位打击俄罗斯资产提供奖励。 费多罗夫的...

reflection.en: Leadership in times of crisis demands not only strategic acumen but also a deep commitment to the welfare and trust of the people. When decisions lead to widespread public backlash, it highlights the vital truth that righteous governance is the foundation upon which authority is truly established. Yahweh reminds us that integrity and justice are essential...

title.en: Rebel Wilson cleared in defamation case brought by actress in her own film
title.zh: 瑞贝尔·威尔逊在诽谤案中被判无罪

summary.en: Actress Rebel Wilson has been cleared by a Sydney court in a defamation case brought against her by young Australian actress Charlotte MacInnes, who had accused Wilson of defamation.
summary.zh: 演员瑞贝尔·威尔逊在悉尼法院被判无罪，此前她被年轻的澳大利亚女演员夏洛特·麦金尼斯指控诽谤。

body.en:
Rebel Wilson has been cleared of accusations that she defamed a young Australian actress, a Sydney court has found.

Charlotte MacInnes, who starred in Wilson's film The Deb, sued the Bridesmaids and Pitch Perfect actress for allegedly harming her reputation in Instagram posts in 2024 and 2025.

In the posts, Wilson accused MacInnes of retracting her complaint of sexual harassment against a film producer so she could further her career - a claim MacInnes denied.

In court on Wednesday, Justice Elizabeth Raper dismissed the case, saying the imputation that MacInnes had changed her story about the incident was not defamatory. The judge ordered MacInnes to pay Wilson's costs.

The case centres around an incident in September 2023 when MacInnes went for a swim at Bondi Beach with Amanda Ghost, one of the producers of Wilson's film.

Ghost had an allergic reaction to the cold water, prompting the pair to return to the producer's luxury apartment that she rented.

Ghost had a shower while MacInnes ran a bath for her. The young actress got into the bath to warm up with Ghost joining her shortly after. Both were wearing swimsuits.

"To say that the circumstance surrounding how they came to be in the bath are unusual would be an understatement," she told the court.

Raper also found that MacInnes had failed to establish the posts had caused or were likely to serious harm.

Wilson posted on Instagram moments after the decision, saying the "process has taught me a lot".

"It has tested me, but it has also reinforced something I've always believed. I want to live my life standing up for what I believe is right, while continuing to create work that brings people joy."

Wilson thanked her supporters and said she was "grateful this chapter has reached its conclusion". She also thanked the judge in her case and "the Australian legal system who I have the utmost respect for".

During the three-week trial earlier this year, Wilson claimed that MacInnes spoke to her the day after the bath incident and said "Amanda asked me to have a bath and shower with her and it made me feel uncomfortable".

Wilson later called MacInnes to ask her about the bath incident again as she was concerned about it.

After the call, Wilson sent Ghost a text, which was shown to the court, that read: "Charlotte says all good. She just meant 'it was a bizarre situation' not that she felt personally uncomfortable."

Earlier, lawyers for MacInnes said Wilson's allegations were "malicious concoctions" and the court heard claims the Hollywood star had ordered a smear website to target Ghost, which Wilson denied.

body.zh: 悉尼一家法院发现，蕾蓓尔·威尔逊诽谤一名澳大利亚年轻女演员的指控已被洗清。 出演威尔逊电影《The Deb》的夏洛特·麦金尼斯 (Charlotte MacInnes) 起诉《伴娘》和《完美音调》女演员，指控其在 2024 年和 2025 年在 Instagram 帖子中损害了自己的声誉。 在帖子中，威尔逊指责麦金尼斯撤回对电影制片人性骚扰的投诉，以便她能够进一步发展自己的职业生涯，但麦金尼斯否认了这一说法。 周三在法庭上，法官伊丽莎白·拉珀驳回了此案，称麦金尼斯改变了有关该事件的说法的指责并不具有诽谤性。法官命令麦金尼斯支付威尔逊的费用。 此案围绕 2023 年 9 月发生的一起事件展开，当时麦金尼斯与威尔逊电影的制片人之一阿曼达·幽灵 (Amanda Ghost) 一起去邦迪海滩游泳。 幽灵对冷水产生过敏反应，促使两人回到制片人租用的豪华公寓。 白灵洗了个澡，麦金尼斯则为她洗澡。这位年轻女演员进了浴缸热身，不久之后幽灵也加入了她。两人都穿着泳衣。 “如果说他们在浴室里的情况很不寻常，那是轻描淡写的，”她告诉法庭。 拉珀还发现，麦金尼斯未能证明这些帖子已经造成或可能造成严重伤害。 做出决定后不久，威尔逊在 Instagram 上发帖称，“这个过程教会了我很多东西”。 “它考验了我，但也强化了我一直相信的东西。我希望在生活中坚持我认为正确的事情，同时继续创造给人们带来快乐的工作。” 威尔逊感谢她的支持者，并表示她“感谢这一章已经结束”。她还感谢处理她案件的法官和“我非常尊重的澳大利亚法律体系”。 在今年早些时候为期三周的审判中，威尔逊声称麦金尼斯在洗澡事件发生后的第二天与她交谈，并说“阿曼达让我和她一起洗澡和淋浴，这让我感到不舒服”。 威尔逊后来打电话给麦金尼斯，再次询问她洗澡事件的情况，因为她对此感到担忧。 通话结束后，威尔逊给幽灵发了一条短信，并在法庭上出示，短信内容如下：“夏洛特说一切都很好。她只是想说‘这是一个奇怪的情况’，并不是说她个人感到不舒服。” 早些时候，麦金尼斯的律师表示，威尔逊的指控是“恶意的混合物”，法庭听取了这位好莱坞明星下令建立一个针对《幽灵》的诽谤网站的指控，但威尔逊否认了这一点。 威尔逊的律师辩称，2021 年从西澳大利亚表演学校毕业的麦金尼斯并没有受到这些帖子的伤害，并指出她最近签订的唱片合约……

reflection.en: In legal proceedings, the initial accusation often seems compelling until all perspectives are heard and examined. This court ruling reminds us of the importance of a thorough and impartial process in discerning truth and upholding justice. Yahweh's wisdom encourages us to listen carefully before forming conclusions.
reflection.zh: 在法律诉讼中，最初的指控往往看似有力，直到所有观点都被听取和审查。这项法院裁决提醒我们，在辨明真相和维护正义时，彻底和公正的程序至关重要。雅伟的智慧鼓励我们在下结论之前仔细倾听。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Meet the women breaking world records in lumberjack sports
title.zh: 认识在伐木工人运动中打破世界纪录的女性

summary.en: The BBC explores the growing popularity of lumberjack sports among women, highlighting their record-breaking achievements and the dedication required to reach peak performance.
summary.zh: 英国广播公司（BBC）探讨了伐木工人运动在女性中日益普及的原因，并强调了她们打破世界纪录的成就以及达到最佳表现所需的奉献精神。

body.en:
Karolina Urbanova had never heard of lumberjack sports until a new neighbour moved into her small Czech village and enlisted her help for events when she was a teenager.

Now 24, she has just broken two world records at the annual Lumberjack World Championships, which were held over the weekend in Hayward, Wisconsin.

The competition, which Hayward has been hosting since 1960, brings people from across America and around the world together to showcase their skills in everything from logrolling, chopping and sawing to speed climbing.

This year, 40 women from across the US and abroad joined 66 male competitors – a far cry from the female representation Urbanova saw when she started out.

"There were maybe like three girls doing this sport in Europe," she tells the BBC, adding: "Telling people from the city that you are chopping wood usually every day, they looked weird at me."

Urbanova was talent-spotted by a male competitor alongside her mother and sister and they began training weekly in a barn - trying out different axes and techniques and getting pointers from more experienced athletes as they entered competitions throughout Europe and further afield.

She discovered she was fast, and her new records prove it. In the Women's Standing Block category, where an axe is used to speed-chop through an upright, vertical block of wood, she cut through 9in (22.8cm) of white pine in 19.38 seconds. The previous record was 21.17 seconds.

In the Women's Underhand Chop, where competitors stand on a piece of wood and chop between their feet, she cut through 11in of white pine in 21.28 seconds. The fastest previous time was 24.26.

Urbanova is perhaps the quintessential example of lumberjack sports' expanding reach, particularly among women. She says that while they are niche in America, they're nearly unheard of in the Czech Republic.

That is not the case for Meredith Ingbretson, a Hayward native, who also broke a record at the world championships – winning the Women's Boom Run, where competitors race back and forth across eight linked cedar logs. Her time was 13.78 seconds – less than a second faster than the previous record of 13.98.

She said she'd buckled down in the past year - cutting out alcohol and anything else that "didn't align" with achieving her long-held goal.

Ingbretson was introduced to lumberjack sports at age three. They are a big part of life in Hayward, which was founded on the timber industry in 1880. It is a place where, as Ingbretson puts it, every resident "has probably been in logrolling lessons at least for one summer".

She has now been competing in logrolling for 28 years and began sawing and chopping more recently.

body.zh: 卡罗琳娜·乌尔巴诺娃 (Karolina Urbanova) 从未听说过伐木工人运动，直到一位新邻居搬进她的捷克小村庄，并在她十几岁时为活动寻求帮助。 现年 24 岁的她刚刚在周末于威斯康星州海沃德举行的年度伐木工世界锦标赛上打破了两项世界纪录。 海沃德自 1960 年以来一直主办这项比赛，将来自美国和世界各地的人们聚集在一起，展示他们从滚木、砍伐、锯切到速度攀登等各个方面的技能。 今年，来自美国和国外的 40 名女性加入了 66 名男性参赛者的行列，这与乌尔巴诺娃刚开始时看到的女性代表相去甚远。 “在欧洲可能有三个女孩在做这项运动，”她告诉英国广播公司，并补充道：“告诉城里的人你通常每天都在砍柴，他们对我的表情很奇怪。” 乌尔巴诺娃与她的母亲和姐姐一起被一位男性选手发现了天赋，她们开始每周在谷仓里训练——尝试不同的轴线和技术，并在参加欧洲和更远的地方的比赛时从更有经验的运动员那里得到指导。 她发现自己的速度很快，她的新记录证明了这一点。在女子站立木块比赛中，她用斧头快速砍断一块直立的垂直木块，她在 19.38 秒内砍断了 9 英寸（22.8 厘米）的白松。此前的纪录是21.17秒。 在女子低手劈砍比赛中，参赛者站在一块木头上，用双脚劈砍，她在 21.28 秒内砍断了 11 英寸的白松木。此前最快时间是24.26。 乌尔巴诺瓦也许是伐木工人运动影响力不断扩大的典型例子，尤其是在女性中。她说，虽然它们在美国是小众市场，但在捷克共和国几乎闻所未闻。 但海沃德本地人梅雷迪思·英布雷森 (Meredith Ingbretson) 的情况却并非如此，她还在世界锦标赛上打破了一项纪录——赢得了女子 Boom Run 比赛，参赛者在八根相连的雪松木上来回比赛。她的成绩为 13.78 秒，比之前的纪录 13.98 快了不到一秒。 她说，她在过去的一年里全力以赴，戒掉了酒精和其他任何与实现她长期目标“不相符”的东西。 英布雷森三岁时就开始接触伐木工人运动。它们是海沃德生活的重要组成部分，海沃德是在 1880 年以木材工业为基础而建立的。正如英布雷森 (Ingbretson) 所说，这里的每个居民“可能至少在一个夏天上过互助课程”。 她参加跳绳比赛已有 28 年了，最近才开始锯木和砍木。 根据...的数据，在过去 30 年里，伐木工运动中的女性参赛者数量增加了两倍多。

reflection.en: The dedication and skill shown by women excelling in lumberjack sports remind us of the focused effort required to achieve any significant goal. Yahweh encourages us to approach our endeavors with purpose, striving for excellence in all we do.
reflection.zh: 女性在伐木工人运动中展现出的奉献和技能，提醒我们实现任何重要目标都需要专注的努力。雅伟鼓励我们带着目标去完成我们的事业，在我们所做的一切事上追求卓越。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: 'Strong concerns': Australia meets with China following ballistic missile test
title.zh: “强烈关切”：澳大利亚在中国弹道导弹试验后与中方会晤

summary.en: Following a ballistic missile test, Australia's Foreign Minister Penny Wong met with her Chinese counterpart to express strong concerns and reiterate the importance of transparency in their bilateral relationship.
summary.zh: 在一次弹道导弹试验后，澳大利亚外交部长黄英贤会见了她的中国同行，表达了强烈关切，并重申了双边关系中透明度的重要性。

body.en:
Australia has raised its concerns with China over its nuclear-capable missile test in the South Pacific, noting many of the region's nations also shared the same view.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong met with her Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, on the sidelines of ASEAN talks in the Philippines capital, Manila, on Tuesday evening.

"You speak about the importance of mutual understanding. I agree, and I expect we will discuss our concerns ... including around peace and stability in our region, safe and professional military conduct, and the importance of transparency and reassurance of intent," Wong said in opening remarks.

Wong noted the "strong concerns" expressed by many Pacific Island countries about the submarine-launched missile earlier in July.

The two foreign ministers also discussed the importance of peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific.

"You've often heard me say that we will cooperate where we can and disagree where we must, and we want to continue to engage because we believe that is in our national interest," Wong said.

Australia was only given a few hours' notice by China of the test, which was launched within hours of Prime Minister Anthony Albanese signing a new defence alliance with Fiji.

Albanese slammed the launch as a "provocative act" while other Pacific nations including New Zealand, Tuvalu and Fiji condemned the incident.

Solomon Islands Prime Minister Matthew Wale was standing beside his Australian counterpart in his country's capital Honiara in early July when he said the test was "not the act of a friend".

Albanese has previously flagged a strong statement would be issued by the Pacific Islands Forum, but the group's disagreement on the wording of the text has resulted in a delay.

A foreign ministers' meeting of the forum will be held in August, where the issue is likely to be discussed.

title.en: 'Business-friendly socialism': What are new UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham's policies?
title.zh: “商业友好型社会主义”：英国新首相安迪·伯纳姆的政策是什么？

summary.en: The United Kingdom's new prime minister, Andy Burnham, has outlined his policy agenda, which includes measures such as energy cuts, rent controls, and approaches to Brexit.

body.en:
Andy Burnham, sworn in this week as the United Kingdom's seventh prime minister in a decade, has opened his tenure with a slew of new policies, branding his own political ideology as "business-friendly socialism".

Burnham was sworn in as the UK's new prime minister on Monday, replacing Keir Starmer, who resigned following months of pressure from his own MPs after just over two years in the job.

The former Greater Manchester mayor, nicknamed the 'King of the North' for his defence of the region during his nine-year stint as mayor, used his first days in office to signal a new leftward shift for the Labour government.

On his first full day, Burnham told the inaugural meeting of his cabinet that he would lead a "cost of living government".

Burnham has branded his political ideology "business-friendly socialism" — with a distinct focus on cost of living measures.

He has unveiled some early policies designed "to do some things that people will feel and feel quite quickly", especially those on the lowest incomes — adding that a longer-term plan would be set out later in the year.

On Tuesday, Burnham announced he will cut taxes on electricity bills — one of the main drivers of the UK's cost of living crisis — in his first move to ease pressures that have angered the public and helped stoke political instability.

Burnham said his government would remove the value-added tax from domestic electricity bills from 1 October, cutting about £45 ($86) from the average annual bill of about £1,860 ($3,554) that households pay.

"We're taking immediate action to cut taxes on energy bills, put more money in people's pockets and bring back hope," Burnham said in a statement, having pledged to give people more "breathing space" in their lives.

The government said it would be funded by cancelling Starmer's plan for a digital ID scheme that would have cost the taxpayer £1.8 billion ($3.44 billion) — but former minister Darren Jones said the ID program had been "unfunded".

The energy announcement is designed to show that Burnham will move quickly to improve living standards after years of stagnation.

He said on Monday his early policies might not "take all of the pressure off" people struggling with rising prices, and that his 10-year plan will be unveiled later this year.

During his first speech as prime minister on Monday, Burnham also said his first ambition was to end rough sleeping in the UK.

He is reportedly considering rent control measures, alongside plans to build more public housing to help bring down welfare spending.

title.en: Flights to return after 40-year hiatus as Trump promises to help Lebanon 'a lot'
title.zh: 航班在中断40年后恢复，特朗普承诺“大力”帮助黎巴嫩

summary.en: Flights between Lebanon and Israel are set to resume after a 40-year suspension. Lebanese President Joseph Aoun stated his objective is a complete Israeli withdrawal from Lebanese territory.
summary.zh: 黎巴嫩与以色列之间的航班将在中断40年后恢复。黎巴嫩总统约瑟夫·奥恩表示，他的目标是让以色列完全撤出黎巴嫩领土。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump vowed on Wednesday to help Lebanon "a lot" as its president, Joseph Aoun, sought the US' backing for a fragile effort to disarm Hezbollah and forge a path to peace with Israel.

Meeting Aoun at the White House, Trump said Lebanon had been "a very mistreated country" that had been "hit hard" for decades.

"It's probably a dangerous place in a lot of ways," Trump told reporters. "But they love the country ... and we're going to help it. We're going to help it a lot."

Aoun, the first Lebanese president invited to Washington since 2009, asked Trump for political support and continued backing for the Lebanese army, which has begun deploying in southern areas under a US-backed framework agreement with Israel.

"We need to support the LAF," Aoun said, referring to the Lebanese Armed Forces. "Without the LAF, everything will collapse."

Aoun's nearly two-hour visit took place as Israeli troops continue to occupy a swath of the country's south and hundreds of thousands of Lebanese remain displaced following Israeli strikes. Hezbollah has rejected the government's direct talks with Israel as well as efforts by the state to disarm it.

The talks highlighted Aoun's delicate balancing act — seeking Trump's help to secure an Israeli withdrawal from southern Lebanon while simultaneously facing pressure from the US and Israel to disarm Hezbollah, which remains a formidable fighting force despite recent setbacks.

The Lebanese president, a former army commander, said the military was "the backbone of security and stability" and the country's most trusted institution.

In a statement after the talks, the Lebanese presidency said Aoun stressed to Trump the "urgent need for a complete Israeli withdrawal from Lebanese territory," calling it "an essential step to consolidate stability and enable the Lebanese state to extend its full sovereignty exclusively through its own forces."

Following his meeting with Aoun, Trump said he would direct his administration to allow all US airline carriers to fly directly to Lebanon— a historic policy shift more than 40 years in the making.

US flights were suspended in 1985 after the hijacking of TWA Flight 847 from Athens, Greece, en route to Rome, Italy, that was forced to land in Beirut. During the 17-day ordeal, a US Navy diver was brutally killed.

The Federal Aviation Administration and Transportation Department did not immediately comment.

Trump's visit came as the Lebanese army moved into an area of the south under a deal with Israel aimed at proving Lebanon can extend state authority and disarm Iran-backed Hezbollah.

title.en: 'It's really going to hurt': The oil route helping keep prices down is now under threat
title.zh: “真的会很痛”：帮助抑制油价的石油运输路线现在面临威胁

summary.en: If Yemen's Houthi rebels successfully blockade Saudi Arabian ships, global oil supplies could come under more pressure.
summary.zh: 如果也门胡塞叛军成功封锁沙特阿拉伯船只，全球石油供应可能会面临更大压力。

body.en:
There are concerns global energy supplies could be crippled and oil prices spike even further after Yemen's Houthi rebels opened up a new front in the US-Israeli war on Iran by vowing to impose a maritime blockade on Saudi Arabia.

And it could put added pressure on the Albanese government to extend the fuel excise discount — which is due to end on 2 August.

Energy supplies have already been stifled by volatility in the Strait of Hormuz — now at the centre of a continuing war that was originally intended by the US and Israel in February to target any Iranian nuclear weapon capability.

Though it's not clear how the Houthis would carry out their campaign against Saudi Arabia, it threatens to disrupt shipping in the Red Sea , through which the Saudis have been exporting millions of barrels of oil.

Lurion de Mello, a senior lecturer in applied finance at Macquarie University, said oil prices, especially diesel, could take a hit.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Saudi Arabia has been pumping quite a fair bit of oil, and exporting it through its ports in the Red Sea, and this oil has been making its way all the way to China and also into refineries into Asia," he told SBS News.

"So this threat, I think it's really going to hurt the supply coming out of Saudi Arabia, and I think definitely will have an uptick on the oil price."

The Yemeni militant group has been fighting guerrilla wars against the Saudi-backed Yemeni government for years. It is aligned with Iran, which considers the Houthis as part of its regional "Axis of Resistance", though the Houthis deny being an Iranian proxy and say they develop their own weapons.

It is not clear how far the group's new blockade campaign stems from its own strategic priorities or is being made on Iran's behalf.

A long-running conflict between the Houthis and the Saudis flared up again last week, when Yemen's internationally recognised government said it had struck Sanaa airport to stop an Iranian plane landing.

The Houthis said Saudi Arabia was responsible and in response fired missiles at Abha airport in the kingdom's mountainous southwest.

Yemen sits on the Bab al-Mandab Strait — the southern gateway to the Red Sea — and closing that would open up a new front in the energy crisis and Iran's overarching conflict with the US.

The strait has emerged as a much-needed alternative to the Strait of Hormuz for global oil flows, with more than seven million barrels per day transiting the strait in June, up from roughly four million barrels before the Iran war.

body.zh: 也门胡塞叛军誓言对沙特阿拉伯实施海上封锁，在美以对伊朗战争中开辟了新战线，人们担心全球能源供应可能受到削弱，油价进一步飙升。 这可能会给阿尔巴尼亚政府带来更大的压力，要求其延长燃油消费税折扣——该折扣将于 8 月 2 日结束。 能源供应已经因霍尔木兹海峡的动荡而受到抑制——现在正处于一场持续战争的中心，这场战争最初是美国和以色列在二月份打算针对伊朗的任何核武器能力。 尽管尚不清楚胡塞武装将如何针对沙特阿拉伯开展行动，但它可能会扰乱红海的航运，而沙特一直通过红海出口数百万桶石油。 麦考瑞大学应用金融高级讲师卢里昂·德梅洛表示，石油价格，尤其是柴油价格可能会受到打击。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他告诉SBS新闻：“沙特阿拉伯一直在开采相当多的石油，并通过红海港口出口，这些石油一直运往中国，也进入亚洲的炼油厂。” “因此，我认为这种威胁确实会损害沙特阿拉伯的供应，而且我认为肯定会导致油价上涨。” 也门武装组织多年来一直与沙特支持的也门政府进行游击战。它与伊朗结盟，伊朗将胡塞武装视为其地区“抵抗轴心”的一部分，尽管胡塞武装否认自己是伊朗的代理人，并称他们开发自己的武器。 目前尚不清楚该组织的新封锁行动在多大程度上是出于其自身的战略优先事项，还是代表伊朗进行的。 胡塞武装和沙特之间的长期冲突上周再次爆发，当时国际公认的也门政府表示，它袭击了萨那机场以阻止一架伊朗飞机降落。 胡塞武装称沙特阿拉伯应对此负责，并向该国西南部山区的艾卜哈机场发射了导弹作为回应。 也门位于曼德海峡——通往红海的南部门户——关闭该海峡将为能源危机和伊朗与美国的总体冲突开辟一条新战线。 该海峡已成为全球石油流动急需的霍尔木兹海峡替代品，6月份每天通过该海峡的石油量超过700万桶，高于伊朗战争前的约400万桶。 伊朗部分封锁霍尔木兹海峡后，沙特阿拉伯做出回应，转移了超过 70% 的海峡……

reflection.en: The news of potential blockades threatening global oil supplies can stir anxiety about economic stability and rising costs. In such moments of uncertainty and fear about what "really will hurt," Yahweh reminds us not to be dismayed, promising His strengthening presence and help. This offers a steadfast hope that even amidst global pressures, we are not left...
reflection.zh: 有关潜在封锁威胁全球石油供应的消息，可能引发人们对经济稳定和物价上涨的担忧。在面对这种可能“真的会很痛”的不确定和恐惧时，雅伟提醒我们不要惊惶，应许祂会加添力量并帮助我们。这在面对全球压力时提供了一个坚定的盼望，即我们并非独自面对挑战。

verse.textEn: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God.
verse.textZh: 你不要害怕，因为我与你同在；不要惊惶，因为我是你的神。

title.en: Jordan faces growing risk of becoming latest frontline state in US-Iran conflict
title.zh: 约旦面临成为美伊冲突最新前线国家的日益增长的风险

summary.en: Jordan is increasingly becoming a direct participant in the escalating Middle East conflict, facing intensified attacks from Iranian forces. The Hashemite Kingdom is now seen as a new frontline in the regional tensions.
summary.zh: 随着伊朗袭击的加剧，约旦正日益成为不断扩大的中东冲突中的最新前线国家。这个哈希姆王国现在被视为地区紧张局势中的一个新战场。

body.en:
As Iranian attacks intensify, Jordan is emerging as the latest frontline state in the widening Middle East conflict. Why is the Hashemite Kingdom a target for Tehran?

Air raid sirens again sounded in parts of Jordan  early Tuesday as Iranian missiles targeted the kingdom.

"The air defense system intercepted and downed tonight three missiles coming from Iranian territory that entered Jordanian airspace and targeted the kingdom's territory," the army said in a statement.

No injuries were reported, but the latest strikes follow a series of attacks that have raised the stakes for one of the  United States' closest Arab allies in the past days: Two US service members were killed and around 30 others injured by an Iranian missile strike on a US base in Jordan last week.

Jordan is one of the eight Arab countries that host permanent US military facilities. Some of the other host countries — particularly the Gulf states — have been the  targets of Iranian attacks since the United States and Israel   launched joint attacks on Iran in late February.

Though  Iran  launched missiles toward Jordan shortly thereafter, there has since been a lull in direct attacks on the kingdom, which has helped to intercept Iranian missiles launched toward Israel, arguing that it is acting in defense of its own airspace. 

" Iran  has reserved itself the right to return fire on any state in the region that hosts US military assets or bases, and Jordan is one of them," Erwin van Veen, a senior research fellow at the Clingendael Institute in The Hague, told DW. "Only the options of Jordan's King Abdullah II are quite limited as Jordan is in a very precarious balance with respect to military and economic dependence on the Americans."

On Sunday, in a first diplomatic escalation, Jordan summoned Iran's top diplomat in Amman to demand an immediate end to what the foreign ministry called "unjustified and blatant Iranian attacks."

The US is Jordan's largest single foreign supporter. Under a seven-year Memorandum of Understanding signed in 2022, Washington agreed to provide $1.45 billion (€1.27bn) annually in economic and military assistance. In 2025, Congress increased this to $1.65 billion, which was triple the amount from 2010.

Furthermore, a Defense Cooperation Agreement signed in January 2021 grants US forces formalized access to Jordanian military facilities. According to a recent report , there are currently 4,000 US troops, more than in previous years, stationed in Jordan.

In March, however, Jordanian Foreign Minister Ayman Safadi insisted that there were no foreign military bases in the country. Kelly Petillo, program manager for Middle East and North Africa at the European Council on...
body.zh: 随着伊朗袭击加剧，约旦正在成为不断扩大的中东冲突的最新前线国家。为什么哈希姆王国成为德黑兰的目标？ 周二早些时候，伊朗导弹瞄准约旦，约旦部分地区再次拉响空袭警报。 军方在一份声明中表示：“防空系统今晚拦截并击落了三枚来自伊朗领土的导弹，这些导弹进入约旦领空并瞄准该王国领土。” 没有人员伤亡的报道，但最近的袭击是在过去几天发生的一系列袭击事件之后发生的，这些袭击增加了美国最亲密的阿拉伯盟友之一的风险：上周伊朗导弹袭击了美国驻约旦基地，造成两名美国军人死亡，约 30 人受伤。 约旦是拥有美国永久军事设施的八个阿拉伯国家之一。自二月底美国和以色列对伊朗发动联合袭击以来，其他一些东道国，尤其是海湾国家，一直是伊朗袭击的目标。 尽管伊朗此后不久就向约旦发射了导弹，但此后对约旦的直接攻击已经暂停，这有助于拦截伊朗向以色列发射的导弹，认为这是为了保卫自己的领空。 海牙克林根达尔研究所高级研究员欧文·范维恩对德国之声表示：“伊朗保留向该地区任何拥有美国军事资产或基地的国家进行还击的权利，约旦就是其中之一。” “只有约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世的选择相当有限，因为约旦在军事和经济上对美国的依赖处于非常不稳定的平衡。” 周日，在首次外交升级中，约旦召见伊朗驻安曼高级外交官，要求立即停止外交部所说的“伊朗不公正和公然的袭击”。 美国是约旦最大的单一外国支持者。根据 2022 年签署的为期七年的谅解备忘录，华盛顿同意每年提供 14.5 亿美元（12.7 亿欧元）的经济和军事援助。 2025 年，国会将这一数额增加到 16.5 亿美元，是 2010 年的三倍。 此外，2021 年 1 月签署的国防合作协议允许美军正式进入约旦军事设施。据最新报道，目前驻约旦美军有4000人，比往年多。 然而，三月份，约旦外交部长艾曼·萨法迪坚称该国没有外国军事基地。凯利·佩蒂略 (Kelly Petillo)，欧洲理事会中东和北非项目经理

reflection.en: As regional conflicts expand and draw more nations into their orbit, it can feel as though peace is an ever-receding hope. Yet, Psalm 46:9 reminds us that Yahweh ultimately has the power to make wars cease across the earth. This enduring promise offers solace and a vision of a future where even the most entrenched conflicts find their end.
reflection.zh: 当地区冲突不断扩大，将更多国家卷入其中时，和平似乎成为一个遥不可及的希望。然而，诗篇46:9提醒我们，雅伟最终有能力使战争止息，直到地极。这个持久的应许为我们提供了慰藉，并描绘了一个即使是最根深蒂固的冲突也能终结的未来。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: China narrows AI gap, challenges US influence
title.zh: 中国缩小人工智能差距，挑战美国影响力

summary.en: At the World Artificial Intelligence Conference in Shanghai, Beijing showcased significant advances in AI technology while promoting its vision for open-source development and global governance in the field.
summary.zh: 在上海举行的世界人工智能大会上，北京展示了人工智能技术的重大进展，同时推广其在开源开发和全球治理方面的愿景。

body.en:
At the World Artificial Intelligence Conference in Shanghai, Beijing showcased advances in AI while promoting its vision of open-source development and global governance.

As China narrows the artificial intelligence (AI) gap with the United States,  Beijing is promoting a narrative centered on "open source" and "inclusive AI" as an argument for its vision of global governance.

During his keynote speech at the World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC) in Shanghai on Friday, Chinese President Xi Jinping expressed China's ambition to take a leading role in setting global standards in AI . He criticized what he described as the "overextension of the concept of national security."

Xi did not openly reference the United States. However, Beijing's effort to position itself as an advocate of a new AI order and challenge US dominance was unmistakable.

This year's Shanghai summit sent several important signals, says Rogier Creemers, assistant professor at Leiden University in the Netherlands specializing in China's digital technology policy. The WAIC indicates that artificial intelligence is now one of Beijing's political priorities, and that China intends to compete with the United States by supporting open-source AI models and promoting AI-driven industrialization, Creemers told DW. He also noted China hopes to win support from countries in the Global South for this effort.

China is steadily narrowing the gap with the United States in AI model development, and its efforts at AI application in industrial processes are slowly maturing. 

Chinese AI model developers have continued to keep pace on the global stage, largely by training open-weight models on limited but advanced computer hardware, Paul Triolo, senior vice president for China and tech policy lead at DGA-Albright Stonebridge Group, told DW.

Triolo believes deployment of AI across Chinese enterprises may be progressing faster than in the United States.

In addition, there is less fear of AI among the Chinese population than there is in the US, facilitating more rapid uptake of AI applications at the consumer level.

Earlier this year, Chinese state media claimed that the performance gap between Chinese and US AI models had "largely disappeared."

Several experts broadly agreed with this assessment, saying that certain benchmark tests of China's  large language models (LLMs) such as GLM-5.2 and Kimi K3 showed the gap narrowing or even fully closing.

For most applications, Triolo noted, China's leading open-weight AI models are cheaper to run and more than capable of handling most tasks.

At the same time, advanced proprietary models from leading US companies such as Anthropic, OpenAI  and Google still retain advantages in areas such as...
body.zh: 在上海举行的世界人工智能大会上，北京展示了人工智能的进步，同时宣传其开源发展和全球治理的愿景。 随着中国缩小与美国的人工智能 (AI) 差距，北京正在推动以“开源”和“包容性人工智能”为中心的叙事，作为其全球治理愿景的论据。 中国国家主席习近平周五在上海举行的世界人工智能大会（WAIC）上发表主旨演讲时表达了中国在制定人工智能全球标准方面发挥主导作用的雄心。他批评他所说的“国家安全概念的过度延伸”。 习近平没有公开提及美国。 然而，北京将自己定位为人工智能新秩序倡导者并挑战美国主导地位的努力是明确无误的。 荷兰莱顿大学专门研究中国数字技术政策的助理教授罗吉尔·克里默斯表示，今年的上海峰会发出了几个重要信号。 Creemers 告诉德国之声，WAIC 表明人工智能现在是北京的政治优先事项之一，中国打算通过支持开源人工智能模型和促进人工智能驱动的工业化来与美国竞争。他还指出，中国希望为此赢得南方国家的支持。 中国在人工智能模型开发方面与美国的差距正在稳步缩小，人工智能在工业流程中的应用也正在慢慢成熟。 DGA-Albright Stonebridge Group 中国区高级副总裁兼技术政策负责人 Paul Triolo 告诉德国之声，中国人工智能模型开发人员继续在全球舞台上保持同步，主要是在有限但先进的计算机硬件上训练开放权重模型。 Triolo 认为，中国企业的人工智能部署进展可能比美国更快。 此外，中国民众对人工智能的恐惧程度低于美国民众，这有助于消费者更快速地接受人工智能应用。 今年早些时候，中国官方媒体声称中国和美国人工智能模型之间的性能差距已经“基本消失”。 多位专家普遍同意这一评估，并表示，GLM-5.2和Kimi K3等中国大型语言模型（LLM）的某些基准测试表明，差距正在缩小甚至完全缩小。 Triolo 指出，对于大多数应用程序来说，中国领先的开放式人工智能模型的运行成本更低，并且能够处理大多数任务。 与此同时，Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Google 等美国领先公司的先进专有模型仍然在以下领域保持优势……

reflection.en: The rapid advancements in artificial intelligence, as seen in global conferences, reflect a prophetic observation that knowledge would increase. As human understanding and technological capabilities expand, we are called to consider the wisdom and purpose behind such powerful developments.
reflection.zh: 全球会议上人工智能的迅速发展，反映了知识将要增长的预言性观察。随着人类理解和技术能力的扩展，我们被呼召去思考这些强大发展背后的智慧和目的。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: How India's youth-led 'Cockroach' movement challenges Modi
title.zh: 印度青年主导的“蟑螂”运动如何挑战莫迪

summary.en: A satirical protest in India against exam leaks has evolved into a significant youth-led movement. This movement now expresses broader discontent among young Indians regarding employment opportunities and educational issues.
summary.zh: 印度一场针对考试泄题的讽刺性抗议活动，已演变为一场由青年主导的更广泛的运动。该运动表达了印度年轻人对就业和教育问题日益增长的不满。

body.en:
What started as a satirical protest against exam leaks in India has grown into a wider movement voicing young Indians' anger over jobs and education.

Riot police fired tear gas and used batons in New Delhi as tens of thousands of supporters of the satirical Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) marched towards India's Parliament on Monday (July 20).

Police in the Indian capital said 60 protesters and 118 police officers were injured in the clashes between demonstrators and security forces. Mobile internet was suspended in parts of the city, including around the Jantar Mantar protest site, during the violence.

Protesters are demanding the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan. Earlier this year, authorities canceled the high-stakes NEET medical entrance exam over a leaked question paper , affecting millions of students and sparking outrage across India .

The CJP began as an online campaign in May and rapidly evolved into a Gen Z street movement , giving a voice to a generation frustrated by unemployment, shrinking opportunities and a failing education system.

The youth-led "Cockroach" party is now posing an unexpected challenge for Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government , prompting a response that combines political outreach with police action.

Modi's rivals have also tried to step in and take advantage of the youth's frustrations.

"Is this how a government behaves? Using tear gas and baton charges against students? This is a worthless government," Renuka Chowdhury, an MP from India's opposition Congress party, told DW.

The CJP movement  gained fresh momentum over the weekend after veteran reform activist Sonam Wangchuk, whose three-week hunger strike has become a symbol of the protests, was forcibly taken to a hospital by police . 

It is not the first time India has experienced major protest movements. Hunger strikes, famously used by Mahatma Gandhi, remain a common and peaceful form of protest in India.

India Against Corruption (IAC) led by veteran activist Anna Hazare, managed to mobilize millions in 2011 and reshape the country's political landscape. A decade later, yearlong farmers' protests forced Modi to repeal controversial farm laws. However, a 2023 Olympic wrestlers' protest over allegations of sexual harassment achieved few of their goals, despite widespread sympathy.

Analysts say the CJP lacks a nationwide organizational network, which the farmers had at their disposal. Yet like the IAC movement, it has tapped into a broader public mood.

"This protest is different because it reflects a much broader cross-section of Indian society," said Yamini Aiyar, an analyst and senior visiting fellow at Brown University. "They are expressing their frustration with a country whose long-atrophied education...
body.zh: 最初是针对印度考试泄密的讽刺抗议，现已发展成为一场更广泛的运动，表达印度年轻人对就业和教育的愤怒。 周一（7 月 20 日），讽刺性的蟑螂简塔党 (CJP) 的数万名支持者向印度议会游行，防暴警察发射催泪瓦斯并使用警棍。 印度首都警方表示，示威者与安全部队发生冲突，造成 60 名抗议者和 118 名警察受伤。暴力事件期间，该市部分地区的移动互联网被暂停，包括简塔·曼塔天文台抗议地点周围。 抗议者要求教育部长达门德拉·普拉丹(Dharmendra Pradhan)辞职。今年早些时候，当局因试卷泄露而取消了高风险的尼特族医学入学考试，影响了数百万学生，并引发了印度各地的愤怒。 CJP 于 5 月开始是一场在线运动，并迅速演变为 Z 世代街头运动，为因失业、机会减少和教育体系失败而沮丧的一代人发出声音。 由青年领导的“蟑螂”政党现在对纳伦德拉·莫迪总理的政府构成了意想不到的挑战，促使政府采取政治外展与警方行动相结合的应对措施。 莫迪的竞争对手也试图介入并利用年轻人的挫败感。 印度反对党国大党议员雷努卡·乔杜里 (Renuka Chowdhury) 向德国之声表示：“这就是政府的行为方式吗？对学生使用催泪瓦斯和警棍？这是一个毫无价值的政府。” 周末，资深改革活动家索南·旺楚克 (Sonam Wangchuk) 被警察强行送往医院，他的三周绝食已成为抗议活动的象征，CJP 运动获得了新的动力。 这并不是印度第一次经历大规模抗议活动。圣雄甘地著名的绝食抗议仍然是印度常见的和平抗议形式。 由资深活动人士安娜·哈扎尔 (Anna Hazare) 领导的印度反腐败组织 (IAC) 在 2011 年成功动员了数百万人，重塑了该国的政治版图。十年后，长达一年的农民抗议迫使莫迪废除有争议的农业法。然而，2023 年奥运会摔跤手针对性骚扰指控的抗议尽管得到了广泛的同情，但几乎没有实现他们的目标。 分析人士称，CJP 缺乏可供农民使用的全国性组织网络。 然而，就像 IAC 运动一样，它利用了更广泛的公众情绪。 布朗大学分析师兼高级访问学者亚米尼·艾亚尔 (Yamini Aiyar) 表示：“这次抗议活动与众不同，因为它反映了印度社会更广泛的层面。” “他们表达了对这个教育长期萎缩的国家的失望......

reflection.en: When young people feel their future is at stake due to systemic issues, their collective voice can rise as a powerful call for change. Yahweh's word reminds us that true justice should flow consistently and powerfully, addressing the deep-seated concerns of a society.
reflection.zh: 当年轻人因系统性问题感到未来受到威胁时，他们的集体声音会成为一股强大的变革呼吁。雅伟的话语提醒我们，真正的公义应如江河般持续而有力地流淌，回应社会深层关切。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Mexican drug lord 'El Mayo' sentenced to life without parole in US prison
title.zh: 墨西哥毒枭“埃尔·马约”在美国监狱被判无期徒刑

summary.en: Ismael "El Mayo" Zambada, a co-founder of the notorious Sinaloa cartel and one of the world's most wanted drug traffickers, has been sentenced to life without parole in a US prison.
summary.zh: 臭名昭著的锡那罗亚贩毒集团联合创始人、全球头号毒枭之一伊斯梅尔·“埃尔·马约”·赞巴达，在美国被判处无期徒刑，不得假释。

body.en:
Ismael "El Mayo" Zambada, a co-founder of the Sinaloa cartel and one of the world's most notorious drug traffickers, was sentenced to life in a US prison.

Mexican drug trafficker Ismael "El Mayo" Zambada was sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole on Tuesday for co-founding and leading the notorious Sinaloa cartel .

Zambada was one of the most prominent Mexican drug traffickers to face sentencing in a United States court since Joaquin "El Chapo" Guzman was sentenced to life in prison in 2019.

"The almost unimaginable amount of drugs attributable to him and the number of murders that we can document is enough to justify Congress's decision to make this a mandatory life sentence," US District Judge Brian Cogan said.

The 76-year-old Zambada apologized "for the harm I caused and for the example I set," urging future generations to "choose a different path."

He was arrested in July 2024 after he said he was kidnapped in Mexico and flown to Texas .

Zambada helped found and lead the Sinaloa cartel, becoming one of the most wanted figures for US intelligence and law enforcement agencies for decades.

According to prosecutors, he ordered torture and plotted murders, including the killing of his own nephew, as the cartel flooded the US with tons of cocaine, fentanyl, methamphetamine and other drugs .

He pleaded guilty to charges that included engaging in a continuing criminal enterprise and racketeering conspiracy, acknowledging culpability for 85 underlying crimes. In exchange, prosecutors did not seek the death penalty.

"I grew up in an environment where violence and crime seemed normal, but now I know that's no excuse," Zambada said in court on Monday. "There comes a time when every person must take responsibility for their decisions. I didn't, and many people paid the price."

Zambada's former partner "El Chapo" is already serving a life sentence in the United States.

He was convicted in 2019 and is serving a life sentence at the federal Supermax prison in Florence, Colorado.

Together they built the Sinaloa cartel into one of the world's most powerful drug trafficking organizations.

The Sinaloa cartel is one of six Mexican drug gangs that US President Donald Trump has designated as Foreign Terrorist Organizations.

Zambada was arrested with El Chapo's son, Joaquin Guzman Lopez , one of El Chapo's sons, who has pleaded guilty to federal drug charges. He has yet to be sentenced.

Zambada's arrest led to a splintering of the Sinaloa cartel, pitting his loyalists against backers of Guzman's sons, dubbed the Chapitos, or "little Chapos."

body.zh: 伊斯梅尔·“埃尔·梅奥”·赞巴达是锡那罗亚贩毒集团的联合创始人，也是世界上最臭名昭著的毒贩之一，在美国监狱被判处终身监禁。 周二，墨西哥毒贩伊斯梅尔·“埃尔·梅奥”·赞巴达因共同创立和领导臭名昭著的锡那罗亚贩毒集团而被判处终身监禁，不得假释。 自 2019 年“矮子”华金·古兹曼被判处终身监禁以来，赞巴达是在美国法院面临判刑的最著名的墨西哥毒贩之一。 美国地区法官布莱恩·科根 (Brian Cogan) 表示：“他所携带的几乎难以想象的毒品数量以及我们可以记录的谋杀案数量足以证明国会决定将其判处强制性无期徒刑。” 76岁的赞巴达“为我造成的伤害和我树立的榜样”道歉，并敦促后代“选择一条不同的道路”。 他于 2024 年 7 月被捕，此前他声称自己在墨西哥被绑架并飞往德克萨斯州。 赞巴达帮助创建并领导了锡那罗亚贩毒集团，成为美国情报和执法机构几十年来最想要的人物之一。 据检察官称，当该贩毒集团向美国大量运送可卡因、芬太尼、冰毒和其他毒品时，他下令实施酷刑并策划谋杀，包括杀害自己的侄子。 他对包括参与持续犯罪活动和共谋敲诈勒索在内的指控表示认罪，承认对 85 项基本犯罪负有责任。作为交换，检察官没有寻求死刑。 赞巴达周一在法庭上表示：“在我成长的环境中，暴力和犯罪似乎很常见，但现在我知道这不是借口。” “总有一天，每个人都必须为自己的决定负责。我没有，很多人为此付出了代价。” 赞巴达的前搭档“矮子”已经在美国服无期徒刑。 他于 2019 年被定罪，目前正在科罗拉多州佛罗伦萨的联邦 Supermax 监狱服无期徒刑。 他们共同将锡那罗亚贩毒集团打造成为世界上最强大的贩毒组织之一。 锡那罗亚贩毒集团是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普指定为外国恐怖组织的六个墨西哥贩毒团伙之一。 赞巴达与矮子的儿子华金·古兹曼·洛佩兹 (Joaquin Guzman Lopez) 一起被捕，华金·古兹曼·洛佩兹 (Joaquin Guzman Lopez) 已承认联邦毒品指控。他尚未被判刑。 赞巴达的被捕导致锡那罗亚贩毒集团的分裂，他的忠诚者与古兹曼儿子的支持者（被称为查皮托斯或“小矮子”）对立起来。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您依赖我们团队提供值得信赖的报告，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您将始终看到我们经过验证的...

title.en: 'Strong concerns': Australia meets with China following ballistic missile test
title.zh: “强烈关切”：澳大利亚在中国弹道导弹试验后与中方会晤

summary.en: Australia's Foreign Minister Penny Wong met with her Chinese counterpart, expressing "strong concerns" and reiterating the importance of transparency following a recent ballistic missile test.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚外交部长黄英贤与中国外长举行会晤，对近期弹道导弹试验表达了“强烈关切”，并重申了透明度的重要性。

body.en:
Australia has raised its concerns with China over its nuclear-capable missile test in the South Pacific, noting many of the region's nations also shared the same view.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong met with her Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, on the sidelines of ASEAN talks in the Philippines capital, Manila, on Tuesday evening.

"You speak about the importance of mutual understanding. I agree, and I expect we will discuss our concerns ... including around peace and stability in our region, safe and professional military conduct, and the importance of transparency and reassurance of intent," Wong said in opening remarks.

Wong noted the "strong concerns" expressed by many Pacific Island countries about the submarine-launched missile earlier in July.

The two foreign ministers also discussed the importance of peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific.

"You've often heard me say that we will cooperate where we can and disagree where we must, and we want to continue to engage because we believe that is in our national interest," Wong said.

Australia was only given a few hours' notice by China of the test, which was launched within hours of Prime Minister Anthony Albanese signing a new defence alliance with Fiji.

Albanese slammed the launch as a "provocative act" while other Pacific nations including New Zealand, Tuvalu and Fiji condemned the incident.

Solomon Islands Prime Minister Matthew Wale was standing beside his Australian counterpart in his country's capital Honiara in early July when he said the test was "not the act of a friend".

Albanese has previously flagged a strong statement would be issued by the Pacific Islands Forum, but the group's disagreement on the wording of the text has resulted in a delay.

A foreign ministers' meeting of the forum will be held in August, where the issue is likely to be discussed.

title.en: China narrows AI gap, challenges US influence
title.zh: 中国缩小人工智能差距，挑战美国影响力

summary.en: At the World Artificial Intelligence Conference in Shanghai, China showcased its advancements in AI technology and promoted its vision for open-source development and global governance in the field, signaling a challenge to existing international influence.
summary.zh: 在上海举行的世界人工智能大会上，中国展示了其在人工智能技术方面的进展，并推广了其在开源开发和全球治理方面的愿景，这预示着对现有国际影响力的挑战。

body.en:
At the World Artificial Intelligence Conference in Shanghai, Beijing showcased advances in AI while promoting its vision of open-source development and global governance.

As China narrows the artificial intelligence (AI) gap with the United States,  Beijing is promoting a narrative centered on "open source" and "inclusive AI" as an argument for its vision of global governance.

During his keynote speech at the World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC) in Shanghai on Friday, Chinese President Xi Jinping expressed China's ambition to take a leading role in setting global standards in AI . He criticized what he described as the "overextension of the concept of national security."

Xi did not openly reference the United States. However, Beijing's effort to position itself as an advocate of a new AI order and challenge US dominance was unmistakable.

This year's Shanghai summit sent several important signals, says Rogier Creemers, assistant professor at Leiden University in the Netherlands specializing in China's digital technology policy. The WAIC indicates that artificial intelligence is now one of Beijing's political priorities, and that China intends to compete with the United States by supporting open-source AI models and promoting AI-driven industrialization, Creemers told DW. He also noted China hopes to win support from countries in the Global South for this effort.

China is steadily narrowing the gap with the United States in AI model development, and its efforts at AI application in industrial processes are slowly maturing. 

Chinese AI model developers have continued to keep pace on the global stage, largely by training open-weight models on limited but advanced computer hardware, Paul Triolo, senior vice president for China and tech policy lead at DGA-Albright Stonebridge Group, told DW.

Triolo believes deployment of AI across Chinese enterprises may be progressing faster than in the United States.

In addition, there is less fear of AI among the Chinese population than there is in the US, facilitating more rapid uptake of AI applications at the consumer level.

Earlier this year, Chinese state media claimed that the performance gap between Chinese and US AI models had "largely disappeared."

Several experts broadly agreed with this assessment, saying that certain benchmark tests of China's  large language models (LLMs) such as GLM-5.2 and Kimi K3 showed the gap narrowing or even fully closing.

For most applications, Triolo noted, China's leading open-weight AI models are cheaper to run and more than capable of handling most tasks.

At the same time, advanced proprietary models from leading US companies such as Anthropic, OpenAI  and Google still retain advantages in areas such as...
body.zh: 在上海举行的世界人工智能大会上，北京展示了人工智能的进步，同时宣传其开源发展和全球治理的愿景。 随着中国缩小与美国的人工智能 (AI) 差距，北京正在推动以“开源”和“包容性人工智能”为中心的叙事，作为其全球治理愿景的论据。 中国国家主席习近平周五在上海举行的世界人工智能大会（WAIC）上发表主旨演讲时表达了中国在制定人工智能全球标准方面发挥主导作用的雄心。他批评他所说的“国家安全概念的过度延伸”。 习近平没有公开提及美国。 然而，北京将自己定位为人工智能新秩序倡导者并挑战美国主导地位的努力是明确无误的。 荷兰莱顿大学专门研究中国数字技术政策的助理教授罗吉尔·克里默斯表示，今年的上海峰会发出了几个重要信号。 Creemers 告诉德国之声，WAIC 表明人工智能现在是北京的政治优先事项之一，中国打算通过支持开源人工智能模型和促进人工智能驱动的工业化来与美国竞争。他还指出，中国希望为此赢得南方国家的支持。 中国在人工智能模型开发方面与美国的差距正在稳步缩小，人工智能在工业流程中的应用也正在慢慢成熟。 DGA-Albright Stonebridge Group 中国区高级副总裁兼技术政策负责人 Paul Triolo 告诉德国之声，中国人工智能模型开发人员继续在全球舞台上保持同步，主要是在有限但先进的计算机硬件上训练开放权重模型。 Triolo 认为，中国企业的人工智能部署进展可能比美国更快。 此外，中国民众对人工智能的恐惧程度低于美国民众，这有助于消费者更快速地接受人工智能应用。 今年早些时候，中国官方媒体声称中国和美国人工智能模型之间的性能差距已经“基本消失”。 多位专家普遍同意这一评估，并表示，GLM-5.2和Kimi K3等中国大型语言模型（LLM）的某些基准测试表明，差距正在缩小甚至完全缩小。 Triolo 指出，对于大多数应用程序来说，中国领先的开放式人工智能模型的运行成本更低，并且能够处理大多数任务。 与此同时，Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Google 等美国领先公司的先进专有模型仍然在以下领域保持优势……

reflection.en: The rapid advancements in AI and visions for global technological governance highlight humanity's remarkable ingenuity and ambition. Yet, Yahweh's ancient warning from Genesis 11:6 reminds us to consider the spirit behind such endeavors, lest our pursuit of limitless capability overshadow the wisdom of humility and collaboration. reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展和全球技术治理的愿景，彰显了人类非凡的创造力和雄心。然而，雅伟在创世记11:6中的古老警示提醒我们，要审视这些努力背后的精神，以免我们对无限能力的追求，掩盖了谦逊和协作的智慧。真正的进步不仅在于我们能取得什么成就，更在于我们如何带着对终极依赖的认知来管理这些力量。

verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: China, Philippines clash in South China Sea ahead of ASEAN meeting
title.zh: 东盟会议前夕，中国与菲律宾在南海发生冲突

summary.en: China and the Philippines traded accusations after a violent altercation between navy personnel in the disputed South China Sea. The incident heightened tensions ahead of a major diplomatic summit in Manila.
summary.zh: 在南海争议水域，中国和菲律宾海军人员发生暴力冲突后，两国相互指责。这一事件在马尼拉举行的一次重要外交峰会前夕加剧了紧张局势。

body.en:
China and the Philippines traded accusations after a violent altercation between navy personnel in the disputed South China Sea. The incident heightened tensions ahead of a major diplomatic summit in Manila.

Sailors from the Chinese and Philippine navies faced off with oars and batons in the disputed South China Sea , with Philippine officials saying that one of its sailors suffered a head injury as a result of the altercation.

The latest confrontation took place on Monday near the Second Thomas Shoal, a contested area where the two countries have  repeatedly clashed before . The  Philippines keeps a military presence in the area aboard the grounded warship BRP Sierra Madre.

Manila said that Chinese Coast Guard personnel had assaulted Filipino sailors as they approached the outpost. 

China quickly rejected this narrative. Beijing's Foreign Ministry said in a statement that the "Philippine side provoked the incident first," by approaching the Chinese vessel in small rubber boats, but then "turned around ​and made counter-accusations, distorted the facts and engaged in malicious ​hype."

On Tuesday, China summoned the Philippine ambassador in Beijing to lodge its complaints, with the Philippines quickly following suit with the Chinese counterpart in Manila.

The Second Thomas Shoal is part of the Spratly islands, a disputed archipelago in the South China Sea.

The Spratlys are key to Beijing's claim of the entire South China Sea, a key global trade route. Beijing maintains its claim to the waterway despite a 2016 ruling by the Permanent Court of Arbitration in The Hague that there is no legal basis to its argument.

China has repeatedly demanded the removal of the outpost on the BRP Sierra Madre, and surrounded the atoll with its ships in a tense territorial standoff that has dragged on for years.

The incident came just ahead of a meeting of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) which was set to begin on Tuesday with foreign ministers of the eleven member states and external partners.

Australia's Foreign Minister Penny Wong, who was in Manila for the summit, denounced Beijing on Tuesday for what she called "destabilizing and dangerous conduct" during the standoff.

Wong, during a visit to the headquarters of the Philippine Coast Guard, also announced a support package for the agency totaling 10 million Australian dollars ($6.7 million) for drone technology.

The US State Department also issued a statement criticizing China's actions, saying its "troubling pattern of provocations against the Philippines' legitimate maritime operations undermines regional peace and stability."

title.en: Chinese, Philippine personnel clash in the South China Sea

summary.zh: 中国海警人员与菲律宾海军人员在南海发生冲突，双方船只上的队员使用木棍对峙，导致一名菲律宾水兵头部受重伤。

body.en: China Coast Guard personnel on a rigid hull inflatable boat clashed with Philippine Navy personnel aboard a rubber boat using wooden batons in the South China Sea on 20 July. According to Philippine authorities, one of their sailors suffered a serious head injury when a Chinese crew member allegedly struck him with a wooden baton.

body.en: Startling new research shows that in many countries – including old US allies – the public prefers Beijing to Washington Earlier this year, a spate of western TikTok and Instagram creators announced that they were at “a very Chinese time in my life” – drinking hot water and wearing slippers around their homes. The Chinamaxxing phenomenon primarily reflected the constant need of influencers for novel content. But social media trends also reflect a growing fascination with China, as the economic historian Adam Tooze has noted . While it broods over China’s economic, military and technical advance, the Trump administration is accelerating Beijing’s diplomatic progress, as striking new polling by the Pew Research Center shows. For the first time, China and Xi Jinping are seen more favourably than the US and its president in most of the 36 major countries surveyed – including Canada, Mexico and Australia. Only in six countries did people rate the US more highly. While Beijing has seen significant improvements in some places, the slump in Washington’s standing is more dramatic. Across 20 countries, the median percentage with a favourable view of China rose from 32% to 46% between 2023 and this year; for the US, it fell from 58% to 36%. Views of China were much more positive in Latin America, Africa and parts of south and south-east Asia than in wealthier European and east Asian countries. Continue reading...
body.zh: 令人震惊的新研究表明，在许多国家 — — 包括美国的老盟友 — — 公众更喜欢北京而不是华盛顿。 今年早些时候，一大批西方 TikTok 和 Instagram 创作者宣布，他们正处于“我一生中非常中国化的时期”——喝着热水，在家中穿着拖鞋。 Chinamaxshing现象主要反映了网红对新颖内容的持续需求。但正如经济历史学家亚当·图兹（Adam Tooze）指出的那样，社交媒体趋势也反映出人们对中国日益增长的迷恋。皮尤研究中心令人震惊的最新民意调查显示，在关注中国经济、军事和技术进步的同时，特朗普政府正在加速北京的外交进展。在接受调查的 36 个主要国家（包括加拿大、墨西哥和澳大利亚）中，大多数国家对中国和习近平的好感度首次高于美国及其总统。只有六个国家的人们对美国的评价更高。尽管北京在某些方面取得了显着进步，但华盛顿的地位下滑更为严重。 2023 年至今，20 个国家对中国持好感的中位数百分比从 32% 上升至 46%；美国则从 58% 下降至 36%。拉丁美洲、非洲以及南亚和东南亚部分地区对中国的看法比富裕的欧洲和东亚国家要积极得多。继续阅读...

This perspective encourages us to consider how nations, like individuals, are ultimately judged...

title.en: 'Shocking vulnerabilities': Trump makes sweeping claims China meddled in US elections
title.zh: “令人震惊的漏洞”：特朗普就中国干预美国大选发表全面声明

summary.en: The US president made broad election security claims, laying groundwork for the federal government to take action.
summary.zh: 美国总统就选举安全问题发表了广泛声明，为联邦政府采取行动奠定了基础。

body.en:
In a speech attacking US election integrity on Friday, US President Donald Trump released intelligence that he said showed major Chinese interference in US elections, reviving his false claims he won the 2020 election.

Trump's allegations about the "shocking vulnerabilities" in the American electoral system appeared to lay the groundwork for the Republican to dispute the results of November's crucial US midterm elections .

It underscored Trump's effort to make election security a central political issue ahead of November's midterm vote, when Republicans in Congress will face the prospect of losing control of both the House of Representatives and Senate — an outcome that would carry significant political consequences for Trump.

"We can never watch a stolen election again," Trump said in the primetime address, referencing his 2020 presidential election defeat by Democrat Joe Biden.

Trump said he was declassifying huge amounts of intelligence data that showed, among other things, that superpower rival China had illicitly acquired 220 million US voter files.

"Over a period of years, starting during the 2020 election cycle, the People's Republic of China carried out what is believed to be the largest compromise of election data in history," Trump said in the televised speech from the White House.

He asserted that members of the US intelligence community deliberately suppressed information about the extent of China's activities.

His allegations contradict an unclassified 2021 US intelligence community assessment that found no indications any foreign actor tried to alter or succeeded in altering "any technical aspect" of the 2020 presidential election vote.

The assessment was conducted under John Ratcliffe, then Trump's director of national intelligence and now his CIA director.

Trump also claimed there were more than 250,000 non-US citizens registered to vote in four states.

Trump has persistently claimed his 2020 election defeat was "rigged," although more than 60 lawsuits produced no ruling establishing fraud capable of changing the outcome, while recounts, audits and his own justice department found none.

After railing against election security in the 25-minute address, Trump pressed Republicans in Congress to pass his signature elections legislation, the SAVE America Act, which has been stalled for months.

It seeks to impose new voter identification and citizenship requirements, despite longstanding findings that voter fraud in US elections is rare.

title.en: 'Truth-teller': Rebel Wilson victorious in defamation trial brought by The Deb co-star
title.zh: “真理讲述者”：瑞贝尔·威尔逊在《债务》联合主演提起的诽谤案中胜诉

summary.en: Actor Rebel Wilson won a defamation trial against her former co-star Charlotte MacInnes. MacInnes had accused Wilson of defaming her in social media posts that implied she was a liar and a sellout.
summary.zh: 演员瑞贝尔·威尔逊在一场诽谤诉讼中胜诉，该诉讼由她的前合作演员夏洛特·麦金尼斯提起。麦金尼斯曾指控威尔逊在社交媒体帖子中诽谤她，暗示她是个骗子和叛徒。

body.en:
After a blistering dispute that spanned continents and years, Hollywood A-lister Rebel Wilson has been found not to have defamed her co-star in a series of social media posts.

The Pitch Perfect star was sued by Australian actor Charlotte MacInnes, who played the lead role in Wilson's directorial debut film The Deb.

MacInnes claimed Wilson defamed her in a series of social media posts that implied she was a liar and a sellout who walked back a sexual harassment complaint to further her career.

The posts alleged the young actor confided in Wilson — and later recanted — that she felt uncomfortable when the film's co-producer Amanda Ghost asked to have a shower and a bath together.

MacInnes denied making or retracting a complaint, insisting she had not been uncomfortable when the pair shared a bath in their swimwear after Ghost suffered a medical episode in September 2023.

Two months after the conclusion of the hotly contested court fight in the Federal Court, Justice Elizabeth Raper found in favour of Wilson on Wednesday.

"MacInnes has failed to establish that the publications have caused or were likely to cause serious harm," she said.

MacInnes' barrister Sue Chrysanthou accused Wilson of a "complete revision of history" littered with dishonesty during her emphatic closing address in May.

"She is a fantastical liar who has made up terrible, terrible allegations about multiple people and her own witnesses have discredited her," she said.

But Wilson repeatedly denied accusations she fabricated the complaint or raised it for leverage during disputes with her co-producers over the film's budget and writing credit.

That was what she had been doing when she posted the stories to her 11 million followers, the Bridesmaids star said.

"I don't classify it as an attack, I classify it as telling the truth," she told the court.

Her barrister, Dauid Sibtain, said his client had "no motive to lie" about something that would endanger her film by driving a wedge between her lead actor and a producer.

Instead, he accused MacInnes of dishonestly withdrawing the complaint about Ghost to ensure her relationship with the producer continued to be fruitful.

MacInnes had received a lead role in a stage production and a six-figure record deal that were linked to Ms Ghost, he argued, and she wanted to ensure she continued to rise.

The young actor sought aggravated damages for the harm allegedly wrought by the posts, including anxiety and a period without work.

title.en: How long is too long to live at home? Australians reveal their answer

summary.en: A new survey in Australia indicates a perceived "right" age for young adults to move out of their family homes. However, the current economic climate, characterized by escalating rents and limited housing availability, presents significant challenges to achieving this independence.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚一项新调查显示，人们认为年轻人搬离父母家有一个“合适”的年龄。然而，当前租金飙升和住房空置率紧张的经济状况，使得实现这种独立面临巨大挑战。

body.en:
A new survey has revealed the age Australians think is "too old" to still be living at home — and the findings land as rents climb and rental vacancies stay tight. 

The survey, from financial comparison site Finder, asked 1,010 Australians to weigh in on how old was "too old" to be still living in the family home, with the average Australian saying 31-years-old was the cut-off date.

It found gen z and baby boomers held the harshest views, both agreeing that 30 was too old to still be living with family.

Millennials and gen x were slightly more forgiving, nominating 32 as the cut-off.

But Finder's personal finance expert Sarah Megginson says those numbers don't reflect the financial reality many Australians are living through.

"We know renters are doing it tough — Finder's data shows 47 per cent of Aussie tenants struggled to pay their rent in June," Megginson told SBS News.

"In many suburbs, renters are spending half of their weekly income or more just on rent, and after other bills are paid there’s not much left over for groceries and simply living."

The accepted benchmark for rental stress is spending 30 per cent of income on rent — a threshold Megginson says many Australians would now consider "welcome relief" by comparison.

She says the housing crisis is pushing back the traditional markers of adulthood.

"The traditional milestones of adulthood are being pushed further back, with many people delaying moving out, buying a home and starting a family," she said.

It's not necessarily a new trend, either — though data does suggest it's accelerated in recent years.

A July report from research firm McCrindle found young Australians were living with their parents for longer. In 2006, 60 per cent of 19-year-olds lived at home — but by 2021, that figure climbed to 70 per cent.

Their analysis found that young Australians were being challenged with high levels of student debt and a competitive housing market — with some returning to the family nest after moving out to accelerate savings for a housing deposit.

Almost three in five Australians (57 per cent) said they're open to or would welcome living in a multi-generational home with their family — defined as three or more generations living under the same roof.

title.en: 'Terrible advice': Advocates call out Hanson's domestic violence 'two-way street' comments
title.zh: “糟糕的建议”：倡导者批评汉森关于家庭暴力是“双向街”的言论

summary.en: Advocates and experts have criticized comments made by a public figure regarding domestic violence, stating that the remarks demonstrated ignorance of the realities faced by victims of family violence.
summary.zh: 倡导者和专家批评了一位公众人物关于家庭暴力的言论，指出这些言论显示出对家庭暴力受害者所面临现实的无知。

body.en:
Brittany Higgins and anti-violence campaigner Tarang Chawla are among those criticising Pauline Hanson's comments that domestic violence is a "two-way street", and that women experiencing it "shouldn't put up with it".

Speaking to Brisbane's 4BC radio on Wednesday, the One Nation leader said that while domestic violence was "wrong", she attributed the crisis to the "pressures of living".

"I'm not saying that it's just men; women can lose their cool as well. Society is under so much pressure than what it used to be," Hanson said.

"I've been through it myself in life, and I just feel that if you're not in a house where you feel safe ... If these women are getting abused by men out there, then don't put up with it."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Chawla, a writer, lawyer and advocate, said Hanson's suggestion was "terrible advice".

Chawla's sister, Nikita Chawla, was stabbed to death by her husband, Parminder Singh, in 2015 . Singh was sentenced to 22 years in prison for her murder.

Responding to a social media post by Women's Agenda, Chawla wrote: "My sister Niki tried to do what Ms Hanson suggests. Terrible advice. He murdered her. It is not as simple as 'don't put up with it'.

The responsibility isn't on the victim. It's on the person who is abusive or violent. Overwhelmingly, that person is a man."

Higgins also took to social media to respond to the comments, calling Hanson's remarks "atrocious".

She accused Hanson of normalising "victim blaming rhetoric in relation to domestic violence when 38 Australian women have already been lost to femicide" this year. That figure is according to advocate Sherele Moody's Australian Femicide Watch project.

In the space of one week in July, two women and two girls were allegedly murdered in Australia in separate incidents.

Then, on Wednesday morning, a 16-year-old boy was charged with murdering his mother, and attempting to kill his 12-year-old sister in a home in Perth's south-east.

Nicole Yade, CEO of frontline service Women's and Girls' Emergency Centre, also expressed concern the comments ignored the realities for many victims of domestic and family violence.

"Saying 'just leave' ignores proven patterns of behaviour that keep many victim-survivors trapped in abusive relationships," Yade said in a statement.

"Following an abusive incident, displays of remorse, love bombing, gifts and promises to change often manipulate victims into believing the violence will never happen again. Too often, the cycle then repeats."

"It also ignores a simple reality: you cannot leave if there is nowhere safe to go."

body.en:
Millions of Australians may have had data accessed by hackers after Origin Energy confirmed it is investigating a cybersecurity incident.

The energy giant is aware of an incident where unauthorised access to customer data may have been granted, it said in a statement to the ASX on Wednesday afternoon.

However, the company said it does not believe the data that was breached includes customer credit card or bank details.

"We understand an incident like this may raise concerns and acknowledge the impact of this uncertainty on Origin customers," it said.

"Our investigations into this incident are occurring as a matter of urgency, and Origin will provide further updates as appropriate."

On Monday 27 July, millions of mobile phones across Australia will simultaneously emit a loud emergency alert as authorities test the nation's new AusAlert system for the first time.

The nationwide test is designed to ensure Australians receive lifesaving warnings during emergencies such as natural disasters, public safety threats and biosecurity incidents.

But family and domestic violence advocates warn the mandatory alert could also create unintended safety risks for some victim–survivors.

Immigrant Women's Speak Out Association in western Sydney says its biggest concern is for women who depend on hidden emergency phones to seek help.

Its CEO, Maria Kissouri, says: "They need that phone in case of an emergency to be able to contact Triple Zero if they felt their life was threatened — that those women's safety might be compromised as an unintended consequence of the AusAlert system."

The organisation has supported migrant women experiencing domestic and family violence for more than 40 years.

A 2021 national study of migrant and refugee women conducted by Monash University's Migration and Inclusion Centre and the Harmony Alliance found one in three respondents had experienced family and domestic violence in the previous five years, rising to 40 per cent among temporary visa holders, who also reported much higher patterns of migration-related abuse and threats.

"What they experience after arriving in the country is abuse from their fiancé, their partner, or the person that they've just married," Kissouri tells SBS News.

As the nationwide test alert approaches, advocates are working to contact victim-survivors who may face risks from the alert — but say they cannot contact some people directly because doing so could compromise their safety.

They're also concerned the authorities haven't provided information about the alert in enough languages.

"Where it's safe to do so, [we've been] calling every woman that we're aware of that has a safe phone and letting her know to have it switched off well before the alert is scheduled, or to give the phone to somebody else, if that's possible," Kissouri says.

"It's often not possible, often people don't have a safe person that they've disclosed the abuse to; many women share with us that we're the first person that really knows just what's going on for them in their home and for their children as well."
